text: Si naafiqiiɓe ɓen haɗitaaki e naafiqaaku, suuɗugol keeferaaku maɓɓe ngun, feññina lislaamu, e ɓen ɓe ñawu bonki woni e ɓerɗe mun, humondirɓe e tuuyo, e ɓen fenooɓe-fenta, fii no ɓe ukkindira gomɗimɓe ɓen, haray pellet, Men yamirte an Nulaaɗo, yaggingol ɓe, Men fooline e maɓɓe, refti hara ɓe hoɗidataa e maaɗa Madiina, si wanaa dumunna seeɗa, tawde haray ɓe halkaama maa hara ɓe raɗoraama bonnere maɓɓe nden ka leydi.
